claims.text:
spectrogram-picture

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:spectrogram-picture` → `ai-spectrogram-picture` → `src/demos/ai/ai-spectrogram-picture`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/165`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#29-spectrogram-picture`. **Packet:** S1. **Level / prerequisites:** intro; `cs:audio-sampling`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** cs:audio-sampling represents time samples; this computes actual windowed Fourier powers with distinct time/frequency axes and a phase-loss countercase.

**Computed primary model:** Eight samples atfs4Hz: window0=[1,0,−1,0], window1=[1,−1,1,−1]. Nonoverlapping length4 rectangular windows. DFT X_k=sum_n x_n exp(−2pi*i*k*n/4), show unnormalized power|X_k|² for one-sided binsk0,1,2 at0,1,2Hz. Window0 powers[0,4,0]; window1[0,0,16]. Window centers .375s and1.375s. Do not compare these raw powers as normalized amplitudes.

**Countercase / boundary:** Swap windows moves energy in time but keeps each window’s frequency pattern. Circularly shift firstwindow to[0,1,0,−1]: powers unchanged although phase differs. This one-sided power picture discards phase and uses a specified short-time resolution, not the full signal or a speech-recognition result.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict which time window contains2Hz energy; recall the phase-shifted1Hz window can have the same power column.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Transform window computes real/imaginary sums and time-frequency cells; Swap windows/Shift phase retain original and countercase power columns. All waveform samples and axes remain readable, no external audio asset required.

**Source obligation:** Declared finite construction and reproduced arithmetic support only this toy. Independently derive every visible claim; acquire an original method body with exact locator before adding generalized performance, history or empirical assertions. Original DFT is declared and independently reproduced. Any broader STFT/audio interpretation needs author/maintainer method body and a normalization/window locator before expansion.
